title: Players Championship Finals, Round One (Stephen Bunting v Max Hopp)
why: Bunting beat Max Hopp 6-5 in round one at Minehead; Luke Littler did not qualify.

title: Gukesh v Sindarov, Game 4
why: Game 4 of the world championship match in Geneva follows Friday's rest day, with the match level at 1.5-1.5; play starts at 9:00 AM New York time and streams free on YouTube.

title: UK Championship, first day (York)
why: The UK Championship opens at the York Barbican, running to 6 December, with sessions at 1 PM and 7 PM UK time (8 AM and 2 PM New York); US broadcaster not confirmed.

title: Gukesh v Sindarov, Game 5
why: Game 5 of the world championship match in Geneva, scheduled for Sunday 29 November at 9:00 AM New York time; streams free on YouTube.
